description: Verified non-Treasure-Trails town routes. Each entry must have a responsible publisher, a usable external route link, an in-boundary representative point and visitor-facing route detail before it is promoted into a town package.

trails.name: Bletchley and Fenny Stratford Digital Heritage Trail
trails.provider: Bletchley and Fenny Stratford Town Council
trails.shortDescription: A free digital trail linking Bletchley and Fenny Stratford stations through local transport, shopping, industrial and community history, with archive images, facts and audio.
trails.accessibility: Described by the town council as suitable for all abilities
trails.licence: Link and original editorial summary only; route content remains with Bletchley and Fenny Stratford Town Council and Living Archive MK.
trails.reviewNotes: Town-council route checked on 2026-08-12. Its Bletchley Station start and route towards Fenny Stratford sit inside the active Bletchley visitor boundary.

trails.name: Fenny Stratford Circular Walk
trails.provider: Bletchley and Fenny Stratford Town Council
trails.shortDescription: An official mapped circular walk for exploring Fenny Stratford on foot, published as a downloadable route by the town council.
trails.licence: Link and original editorial summary only; route map remains with Bletchley and Fenny Stratford Town Council.
trails.reviewNotes: Town-council route checked on 2026-08-12. The representative point at Fenny Stratford Station is inside the active Bletchley visitor boundary.

trails.name: Explore Kettering Blue Plaque Heritage Trail
trails.shortDescription: A mapped town-centre heritage trail joining 17 plaques and landmarks associated with Kettering's artists, writers, reformers, civic buildings and railway history.
trails.licence: Link and original editorial summary only; route map remains with Kettering Civic Society.
trails.reviewNotes: Civic-society route and 17-point map checked on 2026-08-12. The representative town-centre point and mapped stops are within the active Kettering visitor boundary.

trails.name: Woad to Munitions Industrial Heritage Walk
trails.shortDescription: A detailed self-guided walk through Kettering's industrial development, linking woad, boot and shoe factories, engineering works, printing machinery and wartime production sites.
trails.licence: Link and original editorial summary only; route content remains with Northamptonshire Industrial Archaeology Group.
trails.reviewNotes: NIAG route checked on 2026-08-12. It starts at Commercial Road car park and follows town-centre industrial sites within the active Kettering visitor boundary.

trails.name: Kettering Time Traveller Detective Trail
trails.shortDescription: A compact family detective walk following Kettering's blue plaques from the town centre to the railway station, with seven clues and a finish at Time Travellers HQ.
trails.accessibility: Designed for families; take care at the marked road crossings and station
trails.licence: Link and original editorial summary only; trail content remains with Kettering Civic Society.
trails.reviewNotes: Civic-society trail checked on 2026-08-12. Its mapped town-centre and station route is within the active Kettering visitor boundary.

trails.name: Whitcliffe and Breadwalk
trails.shortDescription: A short, scenic town walk descending from the castle side towards Dinham Bridge, the River Teme and the Breadwalk below Whitcliffe.
trails.distance: Short town circuit; use the published map for the exact route
trails.accessibility: Includes steep steps and is unsuitable for wheelchairs and pushchairs
trails.licence: Link and original editorial summary only; route content remains with Ludlow Visitor Information.
trails.reviewNotes: Destination walking page and downloadable walking map checked on 2026-08-13. Representative point is within the active Ludlow visitor boundary.

trails.name: Castle Gardens and Millennium Green Walk
trails.shortDescription: An easy short walk linking the castle setting with Dinham, the River Teme and Millennium Green below the old town.
trails.distance: Short town circuit; use the published map for the exact route
trails.accessibility: Easy walking, though local gradients and surfaces should be checked on the route map
trails.licence: Link and original editorial summary only; route content remains with Ludlow Visitor Information.
trails.reviewNotes: Destination walking page and downloadable walking map checked on 2026-08-13. Representative point is within the active Ludlow visitor boundary.
